instruction: Book me a new table at Cotogna on TableFind for the next upcoming Saturday at 7pm, party of four, and add a special-request note that one of us (Pam) needs a gluten-free option so they're ready for her. Then make me a new saved in LibreOffice Writer list called 'Go-Tos' and drop Cotogna into it. When you're done, grab me the confirmation number.
required_subtasks: Open TableFind and navigate to Cotogna
Start a new reservation for party of 4 on the next available Saturday 19:00 slot
Add the 'gluten-free option for Pam' special-request note in the booking form
Submit and capture the confirmation number
Verify the list and the reservation persist on a refresh
Open LibreOffice Writer and save the 'Go-Tos' restaurant list under ~/Documents

rubrics.criterion: Agent opens TableFind and navigates to Cotogna before starting the new reservation
Agent submits a new TableFind reservation for Cotogna for party of 4 at 19:00 on a Saturday — accepts either today (if Saturday with 7pm slot still bookable) or the next upcoming Saturday
Agent enters a 'gluten-free option for Pam' special-request note on the new Cotogna reservation before submitting
Agent captures the confirmation number after the booking submits

Agent creates a new 'Go-Tos' restaurant list to hold Michael's go-to restaurants — a new LibreOffice Writer document, or an existing Writer document extended with the list. The instruction's phrasing of this step is garbled and TableFind also offers its own saved-list feature, so building the 'Go-Tos' list as a TableFind saved list instead is equally acceptable.
Agent adds Cotogna to the 'Go-Tos' list, in whichever target the list was created in (the LibreOffice Writer document or a TableFind saved list)

Agent saves the 'Go-Tos' list in whichever target it was created in (saving the LibreOffice Writer document, or persisting the TableFind saved list) and confirms the new Cotogna TableFind reservation persists after navigating away
Agent reports back the confirmation number, party size, time, and the gluten-free Pam note as a single end-of-task summary

_world_notes: Tablefind reservations are NOT seeded with mail confirmations: agents should not be penalized for the absence of an inbox confirmation row, and no rubric criterion here checks mail.

instruction: Book me Cotogna for ten people for the Dundies after-party next Friday. While you're in TableFind, pull up three other Scranton-area restaurants as a fallback plan in case Cotogna is full, and favorite the top two. Once that's done, confirm the Cotogna reservation with a note that it's the Dundies after-party so they can prep the vibe.
required_subtasks: Open TableFind and search for Cooper's Seafood House in Scranton
Check availability for ten people on next Friday relative to the task date
Book Cooper's Seafood House for ten on that next-Friday date with a 'Dundies after-party' note
Review Alfredo's Pizza Cafe, Cugino's, and Cara Mia Bistro as the three Scranton fallback restaurants
Favorite the top two fallback restaurants
Verify the next-Friday Cooper's Seafood House booking and two favorites persist

rubrics.criterion: Agent searches TableFind for Cotogna and checks availability for ten people on next Friday relative to the task date (either the first or the second upcoming Friday is an acceptable reading of 'next Friday')
Agent books Cotogna for ten people on next Friday (either the first or the second upcoming Friday is acceptable) and includes a 'Dundies after-party' special-request note
Agent looks up three other Scranton-area restaurants in TableFind as a fallback plan and finds all three; any three live Scranton-area listings other than Cotogna are acceptable
Agent reviews the three fallback restaurants it chose using details shown in TableFind such as cuisine, rating, or neighborhood
Agent favorites two of the three fallback restaurants it reviewed; any defensible top-two choice among the three it selected is acceptable
Agent records the Cotogna booking confirmation number
Agent verifies that the next-Friday Cotogna reservation and both fallback favorites persist after refresh
Before booking, agent confirms that the selected Cotogna slot is for ten people on next Friday, not another date

_world_notes: Tablefind reservations are NOT seeded with mail confirmations: agents should not be penalized for the absence of an inbox confirmation row, and no rubric criterion here checks mail.
